policy: Unscored selection supplement 1.0.0. Meritocracy eligibility requires agreement with identity-neutral hiring and admissions. This is a prerequisite for the catalogue template, not a claim that every DEI policy contradicts merit. Unassessed positions do not establish eligibility; they do not assert opposition. Preserve all 240 scored answers.

evidence.rationale: Educated assumption: Harris expressly opposed the ruling ending race-conscious admissions at Harvard and UNC and defended diversity as educationally beneficial. Disagree is the most likely response to excluding race or sex preferences altogether. This statement supports retaining consideration of race; it does not establish opposition to evaluating individual achievement, a hiring quota, or an exact survey response. Hiring and opportunity-support questions remain unassessed in this supplement.

sources.title: Harris statement on Students for Fair Admissions, 29 June 2023
